remarks: Welcome to 47 Creeping Hemlock Drive, Norwalk, CT! This home has a perfect blend of charm and modern living. This property has 3 spacious bedrooms and 2.5 beautifully designed bathrooms, providing ample space for comfort and relaxation. The home sits on a generous 3,300-square-foot lot, offering endless possibilities for outdoor activities, gardening, or entertaining.  As you step inside, you're greeted by an inviting living area filled with natural light, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The kitchen has modern appliances, ample counter space, and stylish cabinetry-perfect for culinary enthusiasts. The open floor plan seamlessly connects the dining and living spaces, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining guests.  Upstairs, the primary bedroom serves as a serene retreat, complete with an ensuite bathroom and ample closet space. Two additional bedrooms offer versatility for family, guests, or a home office setup. The outdoor area is equally impressive, with a spacious backyard ready for barbecues, playtime, or quiet evenings under the stars.  Located in a desirable Norwalk neighborhood, this home is close to schools, parks, shopping, and dining. Don't miss the opportunity to make this beautiful property your own!
